s2_root_cause: MuJoCo 3.8.0 (old) vs 3.9.0 (A800) rendering differences produce slightly different VLA input images from step 0. Despite identical model weights (all 4 safetensors match) and identical first 4 policy actions, the accumulated rendering difference causes first action divergence at step 4 (act_dx: 0.0888 vs 0.1106). After step 4, both action and EEF trajectories completely diverge: old proceeds to grasp and approach the object, A800 wanders sideways at constant Z. The device_map difference (auto vs cuda:0) is ruled out because first 4 actions match. The detector's false-early trigger at step 33 on A800 is a downstream consequence of the diverged trajectory. Supporting evidence: python (3.10.18 vs 3.10.20), torch (2.6.0 vs 2.2.0), robosuite (1.4.1 vs 1.4.0) also differ and may contribute.
